coreutils: Bootstrap file utilities used only while rebuilding the base; replaced by the Onlynux coreutils root target.
gcc: Bootstrap image C compiler; replace with Onlynux recipe for self hosting.
glibc: Bootstrap C library; minimum runtime ABI set by the build image
grep: GNU grep used by gzip helper scripts
g++: Bootstrap C++ compiler needed by upstream configure checks
glibc-locales: Bootstrap locales used only while testing locale-sensitive packages
perl: Bootstrap Perl required by the upstream OpenSSL Configure script
bison: Bootstrap parser generator required by iproute2 release builds
flex: Bootstrap lexical scanner generator required by iproute2 release builds
autoconf: Bootstrap GNU Autoconf for upstream snapshots without generated configure
automake: Bootstrap GNU Automake for upstream snapshots without generated Makefiles
libtool: Bootstrap GNU Libtool for upstream autoreconf
lzip: Bootstrap lzip decompressor required only to unpack pristine IANA tzdb source archives
